title: Potion of Supreme Healing

sources.title: Potion of Healing
markers: throw it on the ground near

summary: Restore 10d4 + 20 HP and remove Burning when drunk or splashed.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Restore 10d4 + 20 HP and remove Burning.
fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. Splash creatures in a 3 ft radius for 10d4 + 20 healing and remove Burning per the shared healing-potion rule. Aim at the ground near the target to avoid direct impact damage.
fields.Crafting: Extract 3 Ki-Rin Hairs into Sublimate of Ki-Rin Hair and add any Ash. High-level merchants carry it. The shared table lists Jeera as an exception to the usual stock threshold.
